purpose: Bounded durable source archive foundation for a later existing-worker Demo stream adapter. Engineering only; no new economic hypothesis or strategy outcome.
persistence: Synchronous FULL SQLite transactions, immutable message rows, raw/compressed SHA256 plus ordered connection/time/hash chain. Restart closes prior epoch as interrupted; never reconstruct a new epoch from old books.
source: Only supported public Demo subscribed/book/trade envelopes accepted by existing strict source parser; unknown fields rejected without storing payload or exception text.
evaluation: Synthetic fault/restart/capacity tests plus replay of retained479-message feasibility prefix. Reusing that old prefix is engineering compatibility evidence, not untouched strategy validation.
integration_status: Not connected to worker or network. Separate existing-worker bounded adapter and fresh deployed observation remain required.
